meta.title: AD&D 2nd Edition Priest Spells (all spheres, levels 1-7)

notes.rows: The sheet has one row per spell per sphere (1,478 rows). Rows with the same spell name and level were merged into one record whose spheres lists every sphere; other fields come from the first row that has a value.
notes.names: "(R)" in a name is removed and sets reversible true. A trailing "#" is kept as nameMarker (meaning not stated in the workbook). Small words in names (of, the, to...) are lower-cased; otherwise names are as in the sheet.
notes.castingTime: Bare numbers in the sheet are stored as segments written as Ns (e.g. "5s"), owner choice. Other text is unchanged.
notes.range: Values are as in the sheet (e.g. "0", "TOUCH", "10YDS / Level"); no unit was added.
notes.savingThrow: Values are as in the sheet. 49 spells show "0.5" and 2 show "1", which look like spreadsheet conversions of fractions; left unchanged.
notes.location: location and page are the Priest Spell Compendium (PSC) volume and page from the sheet columns LOCATION and PG #. Book abbreviations are in the workbook Notes sheet.
notes.reference: reference is the sheet column "Original Reference" (PHB = 2e Players Handbook, PHB1 = 1e Players Handbook, TOM = Tome of Magic, UA = 1e Unearthed Arcana; others are for future use). Null where blank. otherReferences holds extra distinct values when merged rows differ.
notes.godSpecific: Gods named in the sheet column "God Specific"; null if none.
notes.description: The workbook has no spell descriptions, so none are included.
ownerOverrides: Consequence (5th): stats taken from the Numbers row.
Control Winds (5th): both rows replaced with the values the owner supplied (range 0, VSM, casting time 8, duration 1t/Lvl, area 40ft/Lvl radius, save None, PSC I p.148, PHB).
Santuary (1st) merged into Sanctuary: spheres Protection and Charm (the typo had kept the two rows from merging).
Converse with Sea Creaturs (3rd) merged into Converse with Sea Creature: spheres Animal and Divination.

Spelling corrected in names and area-of-effect text (Annihilation, Assassin, Creatures, Ethereal, Etherealness, Phylactery, Protection, Putrefaction, Sentinel, Strength, Temperature, Vengeance, Wondrous, Permanency, Crocodile, Voodoo, Dweomer, Amorphous, Variable, Vegetable). Spell ids were not changed.
Breathe of Life renamed Breath of Life, reference set to TOM, marked reversible (owner-confirmed). Id left unchanged.

Sphere additions (owner-confirmed): Anti-Vermin Barrier +Animal; Endure Heat/Endure Cold +Weather; Stone Tell +Elemental Earth; Meld +All; Elemental Forbiddance +Elemental Air/Fire/Earth/Water; Grounding +Weather; Fire Purge +Elemental Fire; Blessed Abundance +Animal, Plant; Age Plant +Plant; Aura of Comfort +Weather. Flame Walk reference set to PHB.
Conjure Air Elemental and Conjure Water Elemental duplicated with reference HR (ids priest7.conjureAirElementalHr / priest7.conjureWaterElementalHr); originals keep POSM.
God-specific for Torm (owner): Compel, Hand of Torm, Bolt of Glory, Swordward (godSpecific set to Torm; references left blank).
God-specific for Tyr (owner): Wolfjaws, Hammer of Justice, Sword and Hammer, Resplendence of Renewed Youth added; Message Mote removed from Tyr's list (godSpecific cleared; spell kept).
notes.otherSheets: Sheets "Mielikki Druid Ranger" and "Mielikki Ranger" are god-specific lists and were not imported.
